Identify the segment with a grammatical error in the given sentence:

"He and his friends / does not / want to / attend the meeting."
questions.solution_en:
· The subject here is "He and his friends", which is plural.

· With a plural subject, we must use "do not" instead of "does not".

Corrected sentence:

"He and his friends do not want to attend the meeting."
